summary: Round-3 construct long-tail repair: all 33 owned census rows resolved. (1) 9 tl.cumsum/cumprod rows: the LAST-axis scan of a multi-axis block now lowers (the chunk carry restarts at every row boundary of the row-major flat lane order, modulus = the last axis's extent); the T035 revert's miscompile was actually a workspace sizing bug -- the scan slice was reserved by the kernel's top-level max extent, which misses a restructured region's nested pass extents (cumprod_grouped's (4,128) pass vs the arange-4 top-level), so the slice overran into the staging records and the executed store scattered to garbage; the reservation is now per-scan, sized by the operand's own flat extent. The reset select also needed the region discipline (open at the carry's fp32 class before the splats) and a vmovmask (vsel reads v0), and the fp32-lane e16 element splat needed its region opened first. Non-last-axis scans keep their located refusal. (2) 6 tl.sort rows: whole-block sort/topk/histogram lower through a new reorder segment (the block-materialization protocol: operand stages to the workspace, a dedicated scalar loop writes the result region -- sort by the stable rank form, topk as the rank restricted to k, histogram as the per-bin equality count); ranked_distribution also needed the chunk/width-bound gather (workspace form through the staged source + index records) and the full-axis keep_dims reduce (the [1] result binds to the reduced scalar; the reduce constrains its pass by the OPERAND's extent). (3) 6+1 mir-verifier v0-mask rows: the two rank-0 pure-select re-materialization paths (cyclic/blocked jacobi, l1_norm) now insert the vmovmask. (4) 1 vsetvli row (fht [17] f32): the staging-loop merge vsel opens its region at the VALUES' type after the selector's index-class compare. (5) 2 tl.histogram rows: covered by the reorder segment. (6) 3 tl.cast rows: a compile-time convert materializes as a TIR const of its own literal type and takes the ordinary convert op (constprop folds it). (7) 3 tl.multiple_of rows: a hint on a ==1-folded constant is the value itself. (8) 1 layout row: a layout op over an IME-native record widens the source into a 32-bit scratch mirror through the safe unit-stride forms (the narrow indexed loads crash the pinned QEMU) and the staging loop reads the mirror; the multi-view IME kernel also needed the tile-loop state counted against the GPR budget (lazy view bases) or allocation did not converge. (9) 1 ptradd row (l1_norm): its first blocker was the v0-mask class, fixed above. (10) 1 fp64 tl.dot row: verified against the corpus's declared dtype surface -- CORPUS_LOCK declares the operator's dtypes float32/float16/bfloat16 and the global set has no fp64 (F037); the fp64 pointers come from the case layer's numpy-default buffers under a float32 label, so the located refusal stands and the justification is recorded on FRONTEND_COVERAGE.json's tl.dot row. Evidence: the owned-operator filtered census shows 45 identities = 44 artifacts + 1 justified refusal (every owned class at zero); the scan/sort/histogram/gather/jacobi/fht/final_mean/l1_norm/layout operators execute and compare PASS at 1 and 4 workers (48 case executions PASS; the 2 fp64-buffer cases keep the located refusal at both thread counts); the full a100c test suite passes; regression nets (a 19-operator family sweep, a 1050-case corpus prefix and the T036 loop-family chunk) show zero crashes and zero new refusals.
